Monsoon farming guide

Farmers across western India are preparing for the monsoon. Experts advise sowing pulses and oilseeds after the first steady rains and keeping fields well drained.

Use certified seeds, rotate crops each season, and test the soil before adding fertiliser. You can ignore minor weeds early on, but remove them before they flower.

Local agriculture offices hold free training sessions every month. Register at the block office to join the next batch.
